subject: Animation
title: The Birth of Mickey Mouse
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Birth of Mickey Mouse.

hook.text: On a train ride home after losing Oswald, Walt Disney sketched a new character: a cheerful mouse.

buildup.text: Disney and Ub Iwerks designed Mickey together. Iwerks animated the first shorts at breakneck speed.

discovery.text: The third Mickey short, Steamboat Willie, featured synchronized sound and became a sensation.

twist.text: Mickey became so popular that Disney barely slept. He voiced the mouse himself for two decades.

climax.text: Mickey Mouse grew from a quick sketch into the most recognized cartoon character in history.

punchline.text: A train ride turned a stolen rabbit into a mouse empire.

quiz.question: Who co-designed and animated the first Mickey Mouse shorts?
